ja267:1.2: Bones for skin, lying in water, hairless,
ja267:1.3: Overcome by him I cry wretchedly,
ja267:1.4: You should not abandon me, dear as life.”
ja267:2.1: “Dear sir, I will not abandon you,
ja267:2.3: By the four quarters on the earth
ja267:2.4: you are the one most dear to me.”
